statement.zh: 盘龙城为长江中游早商相关宫城：近方形城垣与城内大型宫殿基址，见 2001 报告。
statement.en: Panlongcheng is a Middle Yangzi early Shang–related palace city with near-square walls and large palace foundations (2001 report).
